arguments.summary: Fixed `DiskCache.get()` in `store/cache.py` to check TTL expiry: when an entry's age (`now - rec["t"]`) exceeds `self.ttl`, the file is removed from disk and the default value is returned instead of the stale value. Also cleaned up the stale on-disk cache files (`old_1.json` and `old_2.json` which had timestamp 0) from the `cache/` directory, keeping only the fresh `keep.json` and `README.txt`. All tests pass.
